intended_object: The canonical map from the W-type `W β` to the sigma type `Σ a : α, β a → W β`, which sends a tree to its root label and its family of child subtrees. It is the inverse of the constructor `mk`, i.e. one direction of the Lambek isomorphism `W ≅ P(W)` for the polynomial functor `P(X) = Σ a, β a → X`. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: Pattern-matching sends `⟨a, f⟩` to `⟨a, f⟩`. This is exactly the destructor that splits a node into its label and its children. The definition is stated for an arbitrary `α : Type*` and an arbitrary `β : α → Type*`, which is the most general setting for W-types. Mathlib has no other definition of this map; it is itself the Mathlib declaration. The file pairs it with `ofSigma` and the equivalence `equivSigma`. The definition is faithful.
